data.body: Scope addition (2026-08-19): `erratic-illhumored-norwayrat` re-parented into this epic. Gerrit 1919 (ticket unaroused-undead-ibisbill) added a CodeReviewConfig re-export that puts src/rebar/config.py at EXACTLY the 800-line cap — zero headroom for the next config addition. config.py was excluded from this epic's original scope only because in-flight work owned it; that work has now landed the file at the cap, so it belongs here. Same constraints as every other child: split along a logical concern boundary, never raise the locked limit, leave real headroom.
